blockers.detail: Apple Developer Program activation and active membership were verified in the official membership page, and access to App Store Connect Apps was confirmed. Program terms were accepted with explicit owner authorization. Google Play identity verification is approved, confirmed by the official Console and the owner's approval notification; phone and physical Android device verification remain incomplete. Google Create app remains disabled, so no Google app draft or platform upload exists.
Owner explicitly provided and authorized public support email a820628a@gmail.com; used in store metadata, App Review email and privacy/support pages.

Apple explicit App ID tw.mars.islandtransport is registered, and the App Store Connect record for 島嶼交通學院 is created with public Apple app ID 6819605203; iOS 1.0.0 is in Prepare for Submission. The Apple 1.0.0/build 1 signed IPA is verified. Google app creation remains disabled, with no Google app draft, package registration or platform upload. Apple platform validation, upload and review submission have not been completed.

Current Apple signed candidate run 37465941274 on macOS 15 successfully archived, signed, exported and locally verified the 32,592,399-byte App Store Connect IPA for 1.0.0/build 1, bundle tw.mars.islandtransport, internalOnly false, source commit 7cd0d7517f1cb2e221a3c13b38a0131df5e32813. UIKit safe-area constraints are included. An independent download matched the CI report SHA-256. Signature, profile, entitlements and bundled resources passed; this is not Apple platform validation, upload, approval or native UI visual evidence.

Local Android upload-signed AAB passes jarsigner and bundletool; its upload certificate is not registered with Google Play. The Apple signed IPA is verified. The owner authorized Chrome use, Developer API key creation and encrypted key storage; owner Apple login in Chrome is still required and no p8 exists. Eight screenshots are uploaded to Apple's Asset Library; Apple binary platform validation, upload, review submission and approval are not performed. No Google platform upload exists.

The newly created Google Play account is personal, so the new-personal-account requirement applies: at least 12 opted-in testers continuously for at least 14 days before a production-access request. App creation is still disabled while account verification remains incomplete; no closed test, testers or elapsed testing period are claimed.

Apple signed-binary profile, entitlements, required manifests and bundled models passed CI and independent package verification; private key files are absent from the IPA. Test-only replay 37489663357 at capture commit 11ebddb passed four actual XCTest cases with zero failures; iPhone and iPad parent-gate final results each prove three cancellation assertions, with matching evidence SHA. Production runtime is unchanged from signed source 7cd0d75. Parent-gate Simulator verification is complete; physical-hardware verification, privacy/network behavior, local speech and offline use remain pending. The owner-confirmed Apple No Data Collected declaration is published in App Store Connect.

Apple store metadata and questionnaires, free Taiwan distribution, identity and review contacts are saved and owner-confirmed; No Data Collected is published. Capture run 37465941350 produced eight genuine Simulator PNGs, hash/dimensions/RGB decode verified and Root visually approved. All eight are uploaded to Apple Asset Library, recognized as four Dynamic Island medium and four iPad 13-inch assets. Uploaded image paths, source 7cd0d75 and hashes are retained. Separate test-only replay 37489663357 proves both Simulator parent gates passed. Existing Chrome captures retain simulated=true. Remaining store identity/contact/questionnaire fields apply to Google Play; physical-hardware audit and binary upload remain pending. Neither platform has an uploaded or approved binary.

Apple identity and App Review contacts are saved and owner-approved in App Store Connect; private values are deliberately absent from this public repository. Remaining Google store identity and review-contact fields require confirmation after App creation is enabled. Google account identity verification is already approved; no private identity or contact values are inferred or invented.
